copy.curiosityHook: Can an illicit suburban gambling haven stay hidden once the cash starts flowing and the neighborhood loses all control?
copy.description: Faced with their daughter's lost college scholarship, Scott and Kate Johansen team up with neighbor Frank to launch an underground, Vegas-style casino in a quiet suburban home.
copy.vibeSummary: Light, funny, and easygoing, delivering broad comedy energy and escalating neighborhood chaos in a compact 88 minutes.
copy.whyWatch: Directed by Andrew J. Cohen, this brisk comedy spins domestic desperation into chaotic excess as regular suburbanites take staggering financial and criminal risks.

allowedMaterial: Scott and Kate Johansen losing scholarship money for their daughter's college
